RagShortTexts: Marib was a pivotal fortified settlement, anchoring regional military logistics and urban commerce throughout ancient Mediterranean conflicts.

Variants.Content: Seat of the Sabaean empire in Arabia Felix, Marib is anchored by the miraculous Great Dam of Marib. This colossal limestone hydraulic barrier tamed seasonal wadi flash floods into twin distribution sluices, greening 25,000 acres of desert orchards and sustaining towering temples dedicated to the moon god Almaqah.

The ramparts of Marib must fly the eagle standard! Whether through engineering circumvallation or direct assault, Rome ensures this fortress serves senatorial order and secures our communication lines!
The markets of Marib belong to free maritime trade, not Roman chains! Carthage supports its autonomy against legionary oppression, guaranteeing that Punic gold and spears will reinforce its ramparts!
